notes: The Binance Square post is a third-party hypothesis source, not ground truth.
The HMM is fit only through 2025-12-31 and is not refit or relabeled on 2026 data.

A state is labeled Bitcoin, Ethereum, or altcoin season by a one-to-one assignment that maximizes its in-sample mean 30-day relative momentum; a candidate fit is rejected unless every assigned bucket is also the strongest bucket within its own state.
Signals and cycle states observed on day T affect portfolio returns from T+1.
Equal buckets mean one third BTC, one third ETH, and one third shared equally among active SOL/XRP/BNB/DOGE signals; unused buckets remain cash.
The 50/25/25 cycle tilt is an experimental comparison and does not replace the equal-bucket baseline.
